about: #4628: each surviving det-port mutant stated `equivalent` or `unreachable`, with the Java change and why it cannot alter observable behaviour; proposed in a PR, reviewed by the owner. A run that kills a stated mutant fails (the claim was wrong). Ids are mutation.py's; before / after are the Java line.

verdicts.equivalent: the change cannot alter anything the program shows (output, screen, files, COMMAREA, abend)
verdicts.unreachable: no input of the program reaches the changed code
verdicts.harness-gap: the change alters behaviour the proof runs but does not compare (open: the harness must)
verdicts.case-gap: an input the case lacks would kill it (open: strengthen the case)

survivors.reason: IMAGE of DFHCOMMAREA (one chunk of its 32767-byte VALUE image): COSGN00C's PROCEDURE DIVISION never references DFHCOMMAREA (it reads only EIBCALEN); the area's bytes are read only by fill_CarddemoCommarea through caBack, into the task's COMMAREA object, which for a terminal task (CC00, never LINKed) is not observable: CICS discards it at RETURN, and equivalence_cics.linked_result drops it (the RETURN / XCTL COMMAREA is out_'s copy of CARDDEMO-COMMAREA).

paragraph()/PARAGRAPHS is only reached from condition() via task.abendOnCondition(label); UPDCUST has no HANDLE ABEND/CONDITION and every command carries RESP, so no label lookup happens.

Cutting s_DFHCOMMAREA to EIBCALEN bytes (X23) matters only to a reference past EIBCALEN; COSGN00C never references DFHCOMMAREA, and the plumbing's own in_ (runs before the cut) and fill_ (runs after caWhole restores the full array) see the whole array either way, so cutting or not cutting is unobservable for every EIBCALEN.

survivors.reason: lastLinkBytes records the COMMAREA a LINKed program returned; no CardDemo program LINKs COBIL00C, so it is never read
PerformExit's constructor without super(null, null, false, false): the default constructor only also records a stack trace; the exception's depth field, the only thing read, is set the same
inside `if (0 != 0)`-style dead branch: the paragraph's GO-TO result is only taken from a block the translator guards with the constant response 0 (SEND MAP has no RESP), so it never runs

condition() returns a value only for a handled, ignored or ERROR-handled condition; COTRN02C sets no handler and an XCTL raises none ignored by default, so condition() throws (the abend) and `to` is never tested
